compare-sync.detail: Compare supported databases and review a schema or data sync script.
compare-sync.lapse: Opening it shows an alert that asks for a license.

query-insights.detail: Find slow, failing and frequently run queries in this Mac’s local history.
query-insights.lapse: The view stays, covered by a license prompt.

result-charts.detail: Plot query results as bar, line, area or scatter charts.
result-charts.lapse: The chart stays, covered by a license prompt.

data-rewind.detail: Review and restore eligible values from a recent save. Not a backup.
data-rewind.lapse: Saves are no longer recorded, and restoring shows an alert.

icloud-sync.detail: Sync selected data between Macs and supported connection data with iPhone and iPad.
icloud-sync.lapse: Sync pauses, and Settings says why.

linked-folders.detail: Read connection files from a shared folder, Git repository or team drive.
linked-folders.lapse: Connections from linked folders leave your connection list.

encrypted-export.detail: Export .tablepro files with passwords encrypted by a passphrase.
encrypted-export.lapse: Exports lose the option to include passwords. Plain exports, and importing encrypted files, keep working.

environment-variables.detail: Resolve $VAR in supported connection fields when you connect.
environment-variables.lapse: $VAR is no longer filled in, and nothing says so: the connection uses the text as written.

team-catalog.detail: Publish connection files without passwords to a shared folder.

team-library.detail: Share connections and saved queries through TablePro’s server. Never uploads passwords.
team-library.lapse: Team connections and queries are hidden until a Team plan is active again.
